AI Taskforce · Update

How AI supports the Sayakaya business and its team

What we built with the AI assistant since September, shown in the live dashboard. Figures are hidden on purpose.

SAYAKAYABoard of Directors · 19 November 2026
SUMMARY

AI turned the analytics team into a service the whole company can use every day

Everyone works from one place

Sales, marketing, operations, customer service and management all use the same dashboard, each with their own login and only the sections they need.

Questions answered in minutes

Campaign, booth, promo and funnel questions that needed a manual report now have a ready screen, refreshed from live data.

Problems found earlier

Early-warning checks flag unusual movements, lapsed investors and data issues before month end.

Controlled and traceable

Every login, export and report sent is recorded, and access is granted per section.

08
BEHIND THE SCENES

Cost and quality controls keep the platform affordable and dependable

Lower running cost

Heavy data queries were reorganised so each screen reads far less data. Further cloud savings are identified and waiting for a decision.

Checked before release

Automated tests run before every update, and risky changes were analysed and stopped early.

Freshness you can see

Each report shows its data date, so nobody mistakes yesterday's numbers for live ones.

Known limits

Daily refresh runs on one Mac, so a day is skipped if it is off. Time saved was not tracked, so impact is described, not counted.
